text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Maho, who is slated to perform a dance for the festival,
arrives with {0} for a meeting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
祝祭で舞を披露することになっていたマホは
{0}と共に打ち合わせにやってきた。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
So this is the stage...
Just the idea of dancin' here has me all nervous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが舞台……
ここでうちが踊るんやね……
なんか緊張してきたわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me.
Are you one of the performers scheduled to dance today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの、
すみません。
あなたが今日、舞を披露してくださる方ですか？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
That's correct, yes.
I'm looking forward to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
そうどす～
よろしゅうな♪

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Well... I hate to say this,
but your partner for today has come down with a case of food poisoning.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなんですが……
実はですね、
今日、
あなたと舞台に立つはずの方が、
食あたりに遭ってしまったそうなんです。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! That's awful.
Is he okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ？　
そら災難どすなぁ。
その方、
大丈夫でっしゃろか？

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, fortunately. The symptoms are light,
but not enough to allow him to perform today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
幸い、
症状は軽いようなのですが……
今日の舞台で踊るのは無理そうだと言われまして。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
That leaves me in a li'l bit of a pickle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうどすか……
それは
困りましたなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
We're going to have to cancel the whole thing at this rate...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
このままだと
舞の披露は、
中止にせざるを得ないかと……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
This dance is the main attraction of the entire festival. Everyone's been lookin' forward to it, too.
Is there nothing we can do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
祝祭の舞は、
祭りの花形。
皆はん
楽しみにしてるんどす。
なんとかならへんやろか？

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Hm... The only solution I can think of
is if someone else steps in to be your partner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね……
どなたかが、
代わりに
舞台に立ってくれればいいのですが……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... That's a fairly big demand...
If only there were someone around here, real close by,
that could be my partner. *glance*
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ、
かなわんわぁ……
うちと一緒に
踊ってくれる人、
この辺りに
いてくれはったらなぁ。
……ちら。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
It's a cryin' shame. This'll put a real damper on the whole festival.
I really wish there was someone who could fill in... *glance, glance*
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくのお祭りやのに……
このままやと
台無しやわぁ。
どこぞにええ人
いはらへんやろか……
ちら、
ちら。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Really?!
Just what I'd expect from my prince.
You know exactly what I'm thinkin'. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんまどすか！
さすが王子はん、
うちの想いが
通じてるんやね♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm so happy that you'd volunteer.
Let's give it the best we've got. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
王子はんが立候補してくれて
うれしいわぁ。
よろしゅう頼みます♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Always there to save the princess when she's in a pickle,
just as a prince should.
Thanks a bunch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
姫のピンチに
駆け付けてくれる。
さすが王子はんやね。
ほんと、
おおきにな。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Now we've got the princess and prince of the Maho-Maho Kingdom
set to dance together. This might as well be our national event.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マホマホ王国の
姫と王子が
舞台で舞を踊る。
これはもう、
マホマホ王国の国事やねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: We gotta make it a success.
text_block_list.orig_text: 絶対に成功させなあかんね。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
You ain't got nothin' to worry about, my prince.
I'll teach you everythin' you need to know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんは
な～んも心配せんでええよ？
うちが、
手取り足取り
ちゃんと教えてあげるさかい。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Now then. Let's get to practicing. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほな、
裏で練習しまひょ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: I'll show you an example first, so just watch how I do it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは
うちがお手本の舞を踊るから、
よう見といてな。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
First, you hold your fan like this.
And then, one, two, three. ♪ One, two, three. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
扇子をもって、
こんな風にな。
はい、
ちんとんしゃん♪　
ちんとんしゃん♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
And again, one, two, three. ♪ One, two, three. ♪
Then you do a li'l spin, and it's over. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ、
ちんとんしゃん♪　
ちんとんしゃん♪
最後は
くるりと回って、
おしまい♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Heehee.
Thanks for the round of applause.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
拍手、
おおきに。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Praise from the prince himself!
Ain't I a happy gal? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
王子はんに褒められてしもた。
うれしいなぁ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I took lessons in all sorts of subjects before comin' to Landosol.
Dancing is something I was particularly fond of.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うち、
故郷にいる頃は
いろんなお稽古ごとをしてたんどす。
その中でも、
踊るんは
大好きやったんよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
All righty. It's your turn, my prince.
Try mimicking how I did it just now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
次は
王子はんの番どすえ。
さっき、
うちが
舞ったのとおんなじように
やっておくれやす。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aaand one, two, three. ♪ One, two, three. ♪
You've got your hand movements backwards, my prince.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
ちんとんしゃん♪　
ちんとんしゃん♪
王子はん、
手が左右逆どすえ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Let's try again.
One, two, three. ♪ One, two, three. ♪
Oh no. Now you dropped your fan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう一度、
ちんとんしゃん♪　
ちんとんしゃん♪
ああ、
扇子を落としてしもうた……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hm... This dance does have a tricky rhythm to it.
It's not the best choice for a beginner...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
やっぱり、
この舞、
リズムも独特やし
初めて踊るには
難しすぎたやろか……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Why, you're all out of breath.
Are you okay? Do you need a break?
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん、
だいぶ息切れてるけど、
大丈夫どす？
一休みしましょか？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want to give it another shot?
If it's a national event, then you'll give it everythin' you've got?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
もういっぺん？
マホマホ王国の国事のため
頑張る、
どすか……？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
You really do care about the Maho-Maho Kingdom, don't you?
I'm almost tearin' up here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんが
マホマホ王国の事、
そないに考えてくれるなんて……
うち、
感激やわぁ……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then let's give it everythin'
we've got together and make it a big success.
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対、
二人で
一緒に舞を完成させて、
マホマホ王国の国事を
成功させようなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Together...?
That's it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
二人で一緒……
せや！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
We can change it up a li'l bit so that we're dancing together!
It's one, two, three, except now we're holdin' hands!
text_block_list.orig_text:
舞を少し変えて、
二人一組の舞にしまひょ！
手を取り合って、
いち、
にぃ、
さんって感じで。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
The rhythm's much easier to grasp this way.
It should be a lot simpler for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この舞の方が
リズムを取るの簡単やさかい、
王子はんも
踊りやすいと思うんよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I can take the lead while we dance.
It'll be a joint effort!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにこれなら、
うちが踊りながらリードもできるし、
二人三脚で頑張れますからな！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Let's get back to practicin'!
Stand facing towards me first, then place your hand around my back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
早速
練習再開どす！
向かい合わせに立って、
王子はんは
うちの背中に
手を回してください。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: As for your other hand... Here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんで、
もう片方のお手を……
どうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Together, now.
One, two, three. One, two, three.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほな、
一緒に。
いちにぃさん、
いちにぃさん。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Um... Would you be able to bring yourself closer to me?
Ain't no need to be shy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
その……
もう少し、
体を近う寄せてもらえますやろか？
恥ずかしがらんでも、
ええですよ……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Yup, that's better.
Your face is so close that I can't help but gaze into your eyes... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
ええ感じや。
顔が近くて、
見とれてしまいそうどす……♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aaand one, two, three. One, two, three.
Heehee. It's almost like we're takin' part in a ball at our castle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ、
いちにぃさん、
いちにぃさん。
ふふ、
こうやって踊ってると
お城の舞踏会のようやわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I'd be wearin' a nice, frilly dress, and you'd be wearin' a tuxedo.
It'd be a big castle with a hall to match,
and we'd dance away hand in hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちは
ふわふわのドレスを着て、
王子はんは
タキシード。
大きなお城の広間で、
二人で手を取り合って踊るんよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
We'd have all sorts of guests from Wonderland,
and they'd be dancin' away as well.
One, two, three-in' to the sound of real elegant music.
text_block_list.orig_text:
周りを見ると
不思議の国からのお客はんも踊ったはって、
優雅な音楽に合わせて、
いちにぃさん……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're doin' well.
We're perfectly sync'd up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
ええ感じやぁ♪
うちら、
息ぴったりやなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Yup. We should be good to go now.
This'll be real fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
これなら
本番もばっちりどす！
楽しみやなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time.
I had a peek out from the wings there,
but there's a whole bunch of people here to watch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうすぐ本番やね。
さっき舞台袖から
観客席を見てみたら、
お客はんがぎょうさん来てはったわ～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The excitement's got my heart racing, too.
Huh? That's not what you meant?
text_block_list.orig_text:
せやねぇ。
うちも楽しみで、
ドキドキが止まらへんのよ。
え？　
そういうことやない？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Well that ain't any good, is it?
Lemme rub your legs for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そら、
あかんなぁ。
じゃあうちが
足をナデナデしてあげますから。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Rub rub, rub rub. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナデナデ、
ナデナデ……♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Your fingertips are so cold. You really are nervous, aren't you?
I'll give you a nice, big hug to warm you up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんの指先、
冷たいなぁ。
やっぱり
緊張してはるんやね。
うちが両手でぎゅーっとして、
温めたるね。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
How's that? Have you settled down?
You don't hafta to be so nervous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやろか？　
少しは
落ち着いた？
王子はん、
そないに緊張せんでもええんよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
If you start to feel nervous on stage,
then just look right into my eyes.
If you do that, then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もし、
舞台の上で
不安になったら、
うちの事だけを
じっと見つめればええよ。
そうすれば……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: The stage'll be our own little world. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
舞台の上は、
うちと王子はんだけの世界や♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Seems like it's almost time.
Come on. Let's get goin'. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そろそろ
出番みたいやなあ。
ほな、
行きまひょか♪

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now for the festival's main event.
The dance of gratitude!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでは、
お祭りのメインイベント！
豊穣を祝う
舞の
お披露目です！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Finally!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待ってました！！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Show us what you've got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
素敵な舞、
見せてねー！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much for waitin', everyone.
We'll be sure to live up to your expectations,
so please enjoy our dance to your heart's content. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
皆はん、
楽しみにしてくれて
おおきにー
一生懸命、
踊らせてもらうさかい、
楽しんでってくださいねぇ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
My prince!
Heehee. Looks like those nerves are all gone now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん……！
ふふ、
さっきの緊張は
どこかへ行ってもうたみたいやな。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I can't get enough of how gallant you are when it counts. ♪
Now then, let's get started. One, two, three. One, two, three.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いざとなると
肝が据わるとこ、
えらい魅力的どす♪
ほな、
いきまひょか。
いちにぃさん、
いちにぃさん。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
This year's dance is different from usual.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
今年の舞は
今までのとは違うのね。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
I like how up close and personal they are, though.
You can feel some real passion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
二人の距離がすごく近くていいな。
なんかこう、
情熱的というかさ……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. They're all really into it.
I can feel my body heatin' up, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
みんな盛り上がってくれはるねぇ。
うちも体が
熱うなってきたわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
They're in perfect sync, aren't they?
Ahh! Now I'm really in the mood for dancing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの二人、
息がぴったりね。
あー、
なんだか、私も
踊りだしたくなるわ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea, actually.
It'll be a lot more fun if everyone joined in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せや、
舞台を見たはる人たちも
一緒に舞えば、
もっと楽しいんやないかな？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Come now, y'all. Let's dance together.
One, two, three. One, two, three. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
みんなも一緒に、
歌って踊りまひょ。
いちにぃさん、
いちにぃさん♪

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
This sure seems fun.
Oh, hello there. What say we share a dance?
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しそうだなぁ。
あ、
そこの君、
俺と一緒に
踊らない？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you the charmer?
Heehee. I'd be delighted. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
素敵な人、
うふ、
あなたとなら
いいわよ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else is having fun, too.
What a lovely sight. It's almost like a real ball.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなも楽しそうに
踊ってくれてるねぇ。
まるで本当の舞踏会みたい。
夢みたいな景色やわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, y'all! It's time for us to close this out!
Take a big turn, and...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
最後は
みんなでいきますえ～！
くるくる回って～！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Twinkle twinkle hoy! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: くるりんぱ～♪

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Twinkle twinkle hoy!
text_block_list.orig_text: くるりんぱ～！！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Now that's some real fervor.
Hehe. I'd say our kingdom's national event was a big success. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ、
すごい熱気やねぇ。
ふふ、
マホマホ王国の国事は
大成功どすな♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Led on by the passion of the dance, Maho and {0}
smiled as they continued to grasp each other's hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
熱気に包まれる舞台の上で、マホと{0}は
手を取り合ったまま、微笑んだ。
